reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static List<Integer> scheduleSlots(int s,int e,int d,List<int[]>b){if(s<0||e<0||s>10000000||e>10000000||s>e||d<=0||d>10000000)return null;var a=new ArrayList<int[]>();for(var x:b){if(x.length!=2||x[0]<0||x[1]<0||x[0]>10000000||x[1]>10000000||x[0]>x[1])return null;if(x[1]>s&&x[0]<e)a.add(new int[]{Math.max(s,x[0]),Math.min(e,x[1])});}a.sort(Comparator.comparingInt(x->x[0]));var o=new ArrayList<Integer>();int p=s;for(var x:a){while(p+d<=x[0]){o.add(p);p+=d;}p=Math.max(p,x[1]);}while(p+d<=e){o.add(p);p+=d;}return o;}}
